name: codebase-research
description: Answer questions about a codebase and its documentation with cited path:line evidence at low token cost: tiered search, bounded grep, mandatory cross-checks for enumeration and absence questions, and an evidence ledger. Ships an optional local index: SQLite FTS5 BM25 search with identifier-aware terms, tree-sitter method chunks for Java and JavaScript, a repo map, and a fact table of SQL tables, URLs, JSP includes, queues and config keys. Built for large or legacy codebases, including code that does not compile.
